question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. Magnanimous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Self-absorbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Magnanimous"** means generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful. (उदार/महान)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite their differences, he remained magnanimous and extended his hand in friendship.
 
 

 
• **"Self-absorbed"** refers to someone who is preoccupied with their own emotions, interests, or situation, often to the exclusion of others. (आत्मकेंद्रित)
 
 
• **Example:** She was so self-absorbed that she didn’t notice her friend’s distress.
 
 

 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Magnanimous"** is **"Self-absorbed"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Self-absorbed**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Altruistic** (परोपकारी): Showing selfless concern for the well-being of others.
 
 
• **Example:** His altruistic nature made him volunteer at the shelter every weekend.
 
 

 
• **Noble** (महान): Having high moral qualities or ideals.
 
 
• **Example:** His noble sacrifice saved countless lives during the war.
 
 

 
• **Gracious** (दयालु): Courteous, kind, and pleasant.
 
 
• **Example:** She was gracious in victory, thanking her opponent for a great match.
